answer: Each identity locks 75 credits and registers a behavior thread of work actions stamped with key, time and task hash. As the tide rises, each action needs a fresh timestamp. All threads pool in the lagoon, auditors comparing them: shared timing or keys mark a rented-thread ring and burn both bonds. Registration is 45, up 8 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,116,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent registers once, pays 45, reclaims it.
